title: Beltworks — Factory Routing Puzzle
description: Draw conveyor belts, sort and repaint crates, and fill every depot — 8 puzzles, a sandbox editor and shareable builds.
concept: A grid factory where crates move one cell per tick along belts you draw with your finger. Sorters peel off a single colour, painters recolour raw stock, bridges let two lines cross, and depots only accept the colour they want. Eight hand-built puzzles teach each machine in turn, then Sandbox hands you the source and depot tools to design your own — export it as JSON, a PNG of the floor plan, or a share link that rebuilds the whole layout.
features: 8 hand-designed campaign puzzles, each verified solvable, with per-level star ratings against a tile par
Five machines: belts, bridges, colour sorters, painters and walls, all placed by drag-painting
Sandbox mode unlocks sources, depots and walls for free-form factory design
Deterministic tick simulation with run/pause/step and a 10-stop speed dial
Share link encodes the entire layout in the URL hash; JSON and PNG export of the floor plan
localStorage keeps per-level layouts, best tile counts and stars between visits

interaction.mouse: Drag across cells to lay a belt path; the belt follows your drag direction.
interaction.click: Tap a placed belt, sorter or painter to rotate it; right-click rotates any tile.
interaction.touch: Same drag-to-draw on touch; the toolbar and level strip scroll horizontally.
interaction.keyboard: B/G/S/P/E/W pick tools, 1–5 pick a colour, Space runs or pauses, . steps, R resets.
